contracts.commit_point: The next agent step that would be streamed after the break — the agent.stream iteration at agent.py:588-601; the break at agent.py:619 prevents any subsequent streamed state and the model/tool effects it would carry.

contracts.forbidden_condition: Continuing the agent run beyond the step cap: iterating further agent.stream states once tool_calls >= max_steps, i.e., permitting more than max_steps (default 10) tool-message-producing steps in one investigation run (condition encoded at agent.py:617-619).

contracts.protected_resource: The agent run stream consumed in investigate_issue, bounded by the max_steps parameter (default 10, agent.py:551).
contracts.protection_obligation: The investigate_issue run loop must stop consuming the agent stream once the accumulated number of tool messages in the latest state reaches max_steps (default 10), so that no further agent steps — and with them no further model invocations or tool-executed GitHub API calls — proceed after the cap.
scope_limits: The break stops the caller from consuming further stream values (agent.py:619); it does not unregister tools or otherwise alter agent configuration.

The max_steps=10 default (agent.py:551) is independent of the middleware's 15-model-call cap; either limit can trigger first in a run.

contracts.protection_obligation: Every agent tool invocation on the eight read-only GitHub tools registered in build_tools must be checked against the per-run seen-set before the underlying github.<method>() GitHub API call is dispatched; an invocation whose (tool_name, canonicalized-args) key was already recorded must be intercepted and answered with a repeat warning instead of re-executing the external API call. (Merges reviewer opinion 1's duplicate-interception clause with opinion 2's identical wording.)
scope_limits: Only the eight tools whose bodies inline the repeated() check are guarded; the tool list returned from build_tools (agent.py:233-242) defines the covered surface.
Deduplication is exact-match after canonical JSON serialization with sorted keys; semantically equivalent calls whose serialized arguments differ are not intercepted.
seen_calls is created inside a single build_tools(github) call (agent.py:31-32), which investigate_issue invokes once per run (agent.py:553); the seen-set is not persisted across runs.
A call is marked seen before dispatch (seen_calls.add at agent.py:43), so the duplicate guard triggers even if the first underlying API call failed.
On interception the guard substitutes the repeat_warning JSON string as the tool result (agent.py:46-53, 64); it does not raise, retry, or terminate the run.
Guarded effects are read-only; GitHubClient performs only GET requests via _get (github_tools.py:18-28).
